input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns only a pass-through of taxes/shipping/insurance charges payable by Licensee (p0051); the General Provisions article (p0144–p0159) runs from governing law through representation by counsel with no insurance covenant, and no other section addresses coverage. Licensor hosts the FX trading platform and processes Licensee data, so the absence of any coverage requirement falls below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and approaches walk-away territory. We insert the preferred coverages as new General Provisions subsection (l) after p0159.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently requires no coverage at all from Licensor even though it hosts and processes our trading data. Our playbook position is commercial general liability of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can discuss lower cyber limits if coverage is confirmed.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Licensor processes Licensee data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Licensor shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law and shall provide certificates of insurance to Licensee on request.
